caption:
Check who's signed in to your accounts. 🔐

1. Open your account's security settings
2. Look for a list of devices or recent activity
3. Sign out anything you don't recognize, then change your password

Do this for email first.

scenes.text: Is someone else still signed in to your email?
scenes.say: Is someone else still signed in to your email? Check in one minute.

scenes.myth: If I close the app, I'm signed out everywhere.
scenes.fact: Old devices can stay signed in until you remove them.
scenes.say: Myth. If I close the app, I'm signed out everywhere. Fact. Old devices can stay signed in until you remove them.

scenes.title: Check your devices
items: Sign out ones you don't know
scenes.say: Three steps. Open your account's security settings. Find the list of devices. Sign out any you don't recognize.

scenes.title: Change your password
scenes.say: If something looks wrong, change your password, then turn on two-factor authentication.
Never checked, and old devices linger. Checked, and only your devices stay in.
